3. **Gate 46:** from #central-random, 14 Oct 2026 (this week). Pree logged it as one more Marrow site for a follow-up and said no action was needed.
4. **Possibly Wichita:** from #central-team, 2 Jul 2025. Pree mentioned a check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher" in the Zoom room hosting the Marrow office hours link. Nobody actually says it's a Marrow store, so I marked it as uncertain.

The 9 Jun thread also mentions three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker that just say "waiting", but those stores aren't named anywhere I can see. I only read channels Hollis is in: #central-team, #central-random, #general, #help-it-ops and #inc-tansley-carrier-api. No other site came up this week.
